38778375_462ec931.text: Interneurons expressing the calcium binding protein parvalbumin (PV) make up approximately 40% of all GABAergic interneurons. However, this is a heterogeneous group of functionally distinct interneuron subtypes. For example, in the hippocampus alone, there are at least three functionally and morphologically distinct populations of PV + expressing interneurons, namely basket, axo-axonic and bistratified cells. Fast spiking interneurons in the hippocampus and neocortex are often PV + positive and target the soma of pyramidal cells.
